subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent TUI delivery default config key for `openclaw tui`, and if so what canonical config shape should own it?
rationale: The requested fix adds a new config/default surface, and repository policy sets a high bar for config expansion even when the UX improvement is real.

options.title: Add canonical TUI config
options.body: Approve a small config-surface addition with schema/help/docs/tests and CLI override behavior preserved.

options.title: Keep flag-only behavior
options.body: Leave `--deliver` as an explicit per-run opt-in and document aliases or shell shortcuts instead of growing config.

options.title: Solve in TUI settings first
options.body: Prefer an in-product TUI setting or runtime preference if maintainers want easier UX without another top-level config key.

recommendation.title: Add canonical TUI config
recommendation.body: Approve a small config-surface addition with schema/help/docs/tests and CLI override behavior preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: He appears in both the initial TUI provenance and recent cross-cutting TUI/config/docs history relevant to the product decision.
